objects.name: Analytic 2238
objects.description: Real-time network monitoring identifies a field device's source Media Access Control (MAC) address changing without a corresponding documented hardware replacement, combined with protocol-level anomalies (transaction identifier reuse, function-code patterns deviating from baseline) for traffic associated with that device Internet Protocol (IP) address. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
